assumptions: Early Tuesday edition for 2026 Week 7. Redraft half-PPR, one QB, typical 10–12 team leagues. Recommendations are editorial judgments, conditional on availability and subsequent practice news. ESPN ownership is not verified; ownership_pct is null. No FAAB amounts or point forecasts are inferred.

scope.two_source_policy: At least two distinct publishers must corroborate factual fields. Syndicated/linked reports do not establish independent reporting. Two-publisher corroboration is the standard used, not a claim of independent upstream data collection. Editorial judgments are labeled; field-level exceptions and unsupported claims are held.

coverage.policy: Identity/team/status corroborated; injury wording only populated when corroborated. Single-source injury detail is explicitly separated. Estimated return dates withheld. This covers published listings, not every undisclosed injury.

conflicts.finding: The requested Week 7 URL resolved to Week 6. Its participation values were excluded from Week 7.
CBS labels the game ESPD; NFL.com and ESPN agree on NFL Network. Publish the latter as the primary US broadcast.
The Texans official schedule confirms Reliant Stadium (formerly NRG). Preserve current naming rather than correcting it from memory.
Reporting differs about missed time. Publish Achilles concern and unresolved availability; no invented absence duration.
Some Next Opponents strings conflict with the verified schedule (e.g. Pittsburgh CLE instead of NO). All package matchups come from NFL/ESPN.
Yahoo percentages differ between analysts and are not ESPN ownership. Native ownership_pct remains null.
The ESPN API returns 25 mixed news/injury records per team and omits many long-term cases; the full ESPN web table was used for the cross-check.
lib/dfs-ledger.ts has no published projections/results. Historical scores are supplied; site hit rate, MAE and bias remain unpublished.
